text:
The independent JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 map classified **98% of the 2021 event area as forest before the loss**. A later year was also observed in the annual series, satisfying the method’s corroboration rule.

For context, Uruguay’s 2021 MGAP forest map classified 68.1 ha of the 81.3 ha event area as planted forest, mainly *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*. It mapped 13.2 ha outside forest and none as native forest.

Together, these sources support the mapped tree-cover loss, but they do not establish its cause or whether it involved deforestation or land-use change.
